cul_pitchFifth.prompt: A reference note has frequency ${f}$ Hz. Raise it by ${k}$ octaves, then by a perfect fifth (frequency ratio $3:2$). What is the frequency of the resulting note in Hz? (digits only)
hints: One octave up doubles the frequency.
A perfect fifth up multiplies the frequency by $\frac{3}{2}$.
cul_pitchFifth.expl: Up ${k}$ octaves: ${f}\times 2^{{k}}={mid}$ Hz; a fifth higher: ${mid}\times\frac{3}{2}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_bordaTotal.prompt: A Borda count chooses among candidates A, B, C: 2 points for first place, 1 for second, 0 for third. ${n1}$ voters rank A>B>C, ${n2}$ rank B>C>A and ${n3}$ rank C>A>B. What is candidate A's total score? (digits only)
hints: First find A's place on each kind of ballot.
Add (number of voters)×(points for that place) over all ballots.
cul_bordaTotal.expl: A is first (2 points) on the first ballot, third (0) on the second and second (1) on the third: ${n1}\times2+{n2}\times0+{n3}\times1={ans}$ points.

cul_brailleCells.prompt: A braille cell has ${d}$ dot positions, each raised or not raised. Not counting the empty cell with no raised dot, how many different patterns can one cell show? (digits only)
hints: Each position has 2 states: raised or not.
Subtract the one pattern with no raised dot from all patterns.
